* spec: session uniqueness redesign (partial index) + paused on collection page

purses-4bhh root fix: make sessions_active_unique a PARTIAL unique index
(one in-progress session per slot; terminal/soft-deleted free the slot) +
aligned createSession guard. purses-ydeu: collection page surfaces paused.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* spec: fold adversarial review into session-uniqueness redesign

BLOCK resolved: restore-collision (partial index introduces a 500 on undo)
made slot-aware (catch->409); findInProgress redirected to the restore path
(SessionService is dead code); existing conflict test reconciled (soft-deleted
now 201); migration hand-authored (drizzle-kit 0.20.17 can't serialize a
partial predicate) + drift guard; paused Resume uses ResumeControl + person-side copy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(session): slot-aware restore (409 not 500) + findInProgress + reconcile conflict tests (purses-4bhh)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(collections): surface paused sessions on the collection page with a real un-pause (purses-ydeu)

A PAUSED session is the *current* one but showed no card on the collection
page (it only matched status==='active'). The collection page now matches
active OR paused, and ActiveSessionPanel renders status-aware:

- paused → person-side copy ("Your sort is paused" / "Your sort is safe —
  pick up where you left off.") mirroring the sort landing
- paused Resume uses ResumeControl (PATCH status:active THEN navigate), not a
  bare Link that would land the curator mid-sort while the row stays paused —
  desyncing the in-progress predicate
- Badge is status-driven (was hardcoded active)
- set-aside / undo behaviour unchanged; panel stays mounted unconditionally so
  the PR2/PR3 undo-survival does not regress

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(e2e): create-after-set-aside succeeds + paused collection card (purses-4bhh/ydeu)

Two journeys this branch's session-uniqueness redesign unblocked, proven
through the real UI across all three viewport projects:

- create-after-set-aside (purses-4bhh): set the active session aside on the
  collection page (two-step DELETE), then start a NEW sort from the sort
  landing — the POST /api/sessions returns 201 and lands on a fresh triage URL,
  not the 409/500 a held slot used to force. The partial sessions_active_unique
  index frees the slot once the row is soft-deleted.
- paused collection card (purses-ydeu): pause via the real "Take a break"
  chrome, then the collection page (/collections/{slug}) surfaces the
  status-aware paused card ("Your sort is paused" / "Your sort is safe"), and
  its ResumeControl PATCHes status:active before returning to the sort — with
  the un-pause re-verified as persisted.

Adds a "collection-paused" screenshot surface (reusing the paused seed) for
light+dark shots of the collection paused card.
